title: Woman saw three plus signs rolling on road in 1930s

plain: In Sweden in the 1930s, a woman is said to have seen three objects shaped like plus signs rolling along a road. The Swedish researcher Clas Svahn tells Michels he heard the account from someone he names, and his telling mentions calling his mother about it ("I called her"). It is offered as an early sighting from well before the UFO era began.
